svg.aria-label: Map of fire detections on 8 November and the paths of air reaching Lahore, Faisalabad and Multan on Monday morning
svg.text: Where Monday morning's air came from
Modelled 24-hour back-paths of air arriving at 9 am Monday (10 m and 925 hPa winds, GFS), over Sunday's fire spots
Lahore · Faisalabad · Multan; dot = 24 h earlier
Paths from GFS winds (Open-Meteo, 0.5°), horizontal only: a guide to direction, not a dispersion model. Dashed line: Pakistan–India boundary. HamariHawa
